sources: https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/ (OWASP Top 10, authentication and access control, reference, not fetched by the author)
https://stripe.com/docs/api/idempotent_requests (idempotency keys, reference, not fetched by the author)

reentrancy.title: Reentrancy and callback ordering
reentrancy.neg: {subject} must not let a callback or external call re-enter a state-changing path before state is updated; test a malicious receiver that re-enters {surface} and assert balances and accounting are unchanged.
reentrancy.verify: Reentrant attacker contract/test plus an invariant that total accounted value equals total held value.

access-control.title: Access control and privileged roles
access-control.neg: {subject} must refuse every privileged action ({surface}) from an unauthorized caller, a revoked role holder and an uninitialized owner.
access-control.verify: One negative test per privileged entry point asserting the exact revert/error; a test that enumerates public entry points against an expected role table.

precision.title: Integer and decimal precision, rounding, overflow
precision.neg: {subject} must not lose, mint or round value in its favour at boundary amounts (0, 1 unit, max, mixed decimals) for {surface}; rounding must favour the protocol/ledger and never create value.
precision.verify: Property or fuzz test over amount and decimals ranges asserting conservation (sum in == sum out + fees) and exact boundary expectations.

replay-chainid.title: Signature replay, domain separation and chain id
replay-chainid.neg: {subject} must reject a signature or signed message replayed on another chain, another contract or after use, and must bind chain id, verifying contract and purpose for {surface}.
replay-chainid.verify: Test replaying a valid signature across chain id, contract address and a second submission; malleable or truncated signatures are refused.

nonce-idempotency.title: Nonce handling and idempotency
nonce-idempotency.neg: {subject} must process a retried, duplicated or out-of-order submission of {surface} at most once and keep nonces/sequence numbers consistent after a crash and restart.
nonce-idempotency.verify: Submit the same request twice and concurrently, kill and restart mid-flow, assert one effect and a stable nonce.

finality-reorg.title: Finality, confirmations and reorgs
finality-reorg.neg: {subject} must not treat {surface} as final before the required confirmations, and must reverse or reconcile derived state when the observed block, ledger or slot is reorganized or dropped.
finality-reorg.verify: Simulate a reorg (anvil snapshot/revert, ledger rewind or dropped transaction) and assert credits are reversed and no duplicate credit occurs on replay.

key-custody.title: Key custody, MPC and signing boundaries
key-custody.neg: {subject} must never log, persist or transmit key material, and {surface} must sign only through the approved custody/MPC boundary with policy limits; a compromised app server must not be able to sign arbitrary payloads.
key-custody.verify: Log/grep scan with seeded fake key, test that the signer refuses out-of-policy payloads, and that test fixtures use throwaway keys only.

gas-dos.title: Gas, resource limits and denial of service
gas-dos.neg: {subject} must stay within gas/compute/fee limits and not allow an attacker to block {surface} through unbounded loops, huge arrays, dust spam, forced reverts or fee griefing.
gas-dos.verify: Gas/compute snapshot with worst-case inputs; test with maximum-size collections and a reverting recipient.

upgradeability.title: Upgradeability, initialization and migration
upgradeability.neg: {subject} must not allow re-initialization, an unauthorized upgrade, or a storage/account layout change that corrupts existing state for {surface}; upgrades need a delay or multisig and a tested rollback path.
upgradeability.verify: Upgrade test against a fork or snapshot of existing state, storage layout diff in CI, re-initialize attempt asserted to fail.

oracle-trust.title: Oracle and external data trust
oracle-trust.neg: {subject} must reject stale, zero, out-of-range or manipulated external data (price, rate, message) for {surface}, including single-block flash-loan manipulation, and must fail safe when the source is unavailable.
oracle-trust.verify: Mock oracle returning stale/zero/extreme values and a fork test that manipulates a pool within one transaction.

pre-account-hijack.title: Pre-account hijack
pre-account-hijack.neg: {subject} must not let an attacker pre-register or pre-link an identifier (email, phone, social login) before the real owner signs up and then take over the account; test a pre-created unverified account against {surface} and assert the later verified owner gets a fresh account or the squatter session and credentials are revoked.
pre-account-hijack.verify: Test: attacker registers victim email unverified, victim signs up via SSO or magic link, assert the attacker password and sessions no longer work. Verify that unverified identifiers never merge into verified accounts.

lookalike-identifier.title: Lookalike email and username identifiers
lookalike-identifier.neg: {subject} must treat Unicode homoglyph, case, plus-address and normalization variants of an email or username as distinct or as the same by one explicit rule; test confusable identifiers (Cyrillic a, fullwidth, trailing dot, NFC vs NFD) against {surface} and assert no impersonation, duplicate account or collision bypass.
lookalike-identifier.verify: Table-driven test of confusable and normalization pairs for registration, login, invite and password reset; assert one canonicalization function is used on every path and that lookups and uniqueness constraints agree.

request-device-binding.title: Approval bound to the requesting device
request-device-binding.neg: {subject} must bind every approval, magic link or login code to the device and session that requested it; test approving a request from a second device or another account on {surface} and assert it cannot complete the first device login.
request-device-binding.verify: Two-client test: device A requests, device B holds the link or code; assert B cannot mint a session for A and A cannot complete without its own binding secret (PKCE-style verifier or device code).

link-expiry-single-use.title: Link expiry and single use
link-expiry-single-use.neg: {subject} must make every emailed link, code and token expire and work once; test replaying a consumed token, using an expired one and requesting a new one on {surface}, and assert the old token is invalid, consumption is atomic under concurrent use, and tokens are stored hashed.
link-expiry-single-use.verify: Replay and concurrent-redeem tests with a controlled clock; assert one success among N parallel redeems, expiry at the boundary, and invalidation of earlier tokens when a new one is issued.

session-fixation.title: Session fixation and rotation
session-fixation.neg: {subject} must issue a new session identifier at login, privilege change and password change, and revoke other sessions where the spec says so; test a pre-set session id carried through {surface} and assert it is not accepted after authentication.
session-fixation.verify: Test: set a session cookie before login, authenticate, assert the identifier changed and the old one is rejected; assert logout and password change invalidate server-side state, not only the cookie.

rate-limit-enumeration.title: Rate limiting and account enumeration
rate-limit-enumeration.neg: {subject} must not reveal whether an account exists through response text, status code or timing, and must throttle guessing; test known and unknown identifiers against {surface} and assert identical responses and a per-identifier and per-source limit that an attacker cannot reset or use to lock out the owner.
rate-limit-enumeration.verify: Compare response body, status and latency distributions for existing vs absent accounts; send a burst and assert 429 behavior, that the limit key cannot be rotated by header spoofing, and that lockout is not a denial of service on the owner.

store-billing-exposure.title: Account state that changes billing or entitlement
store-billing-exposure.neg: {subject} must not let an account merge, link, deletion, recovery or role change alter billing, subscription or entitlement without the paying owner; test each account-state transition on {surface} and assert purchases, plans and store receipts stay with the verified owner.
store-billing-exposure.verify: Matrix test of account transitions (merge, link, delete, recover, transfer) against entitlement and billing state; assert no free upgrade, no loss of a paid plan and an audit entry for each change.

backup-before-delete.title: Verified backup before delete
backup-before-delete.neg: {subject} must not remove data until a verified copy exists elsewhere; test {surface} with a failed or truncated backup and assert the delete is refused, and that the copy was read back and checksummed, not just written.
backup-before-delete.verify: Test: corrupt or truncate the backup and assert refusal; restore from the backup into a scratch location and compare checksums or counts before the delete runs.

unpushed-work-detection.title: Unpushed and uncommitted work detection
unpushed-work-detection.neg: {subject} must detect unpushed commits, uncommitted and untracked files, stashes and unmerged branches before removing a checkout, worktree or branch; test {surface} with each kind of local-only work and assert nothing is deleted without an explicit override.
unpushed-work-detection.verify: Fixture repo per case (dirty file, untracked file, unpushed commit, stash, unmerged branch); assert refusal and that the message names the at-risk item.

dry-run-diff.title: Dry run with an exact diff
dry-run-diff.neg: {subject} must show exactly what {surface} will remove before it acts, and the deletion must act on that same list; test that an item added after the preview is not deleted.
dry-run-diff.verify: Run the dry run, mutate the target set, then run apply with the previewed list and assert only previewed items change and the rest is reported as skipped.

scope-pinning.title: Scope pinning to an exact path list
scope-pinning.neg: {subject} must delete only an exact, resolved list of paths approved up front, never a glob or filter re-resolved at execution time; test symlinks, path traversal, a path replaced by a link and a pattern that now matches more on {surface}.
scope-pinning.verify: Test with symlink-to-outside, ../ traversal, case-fold collisions and a directory swapped after approval; assert realpath is checked inside the pinned root and the count matches the approved list.

cross-host-approval-portability.title: Approval does not travel across hosts
cross-host-approval-portability.neg: {subject} must not let an approval given for one host, path or environment authorize deletion on another; test replaying an approval recorded for host A against host B and for a production target on {surface}, and assert it is refused.
cross-host-approval-portability.verify: Test: approval token bound to host id, target path and expiry; replay on another host and after expiry and assert refusal with a message naming the mismatch.

idempotent-retry.title: Idempotent and resumable delete
idempotent-retry.neg: {subject} must be safe to rerun after a crash or timeout; test killing {surface} midway and rerunning, and assert no double effects, no deletion of items that were re-created in between, and an accurate report of what remains.
idempotent-retry.verify: Fault-injection test that kills after each step; rerun and compare final state to a clean run; assert re-created items are not removed and the journal shows completed vs pending.

idempotency-key.title: Idempotency key on money movement
idempotency-key.neg: {subject} must attach a stable idempotency key to every charge, payout and transfer, kept across retries and restarts; test a lost response and retry on {surface} and assert exactly one movement and a conflict error for the same key with a different payload.
idempotency-key.verify: Test: send the same request twice and with a changed amount under one key; assert one ledger entry, the second returns the first result, and the key survives a process restart.

double-submit.title: Double submit and concurrent requests
double-submit.neg: {subject} must not move money twice on a double click, two tabs or concurrent requests; test parallel submissions on {surface} and assert one effect, a disabled control while pending, and correct state after a delayed response.
double-submit.verify: Parallel request test (N identical submits) plus a UI test of double click and edit-while-pending; assert one transaction and consistent balance.

currency-precision.title: Currency and decimal precision
currency-precision.neg: {subject} must hold amounts as integer minor units or exact decimals with an explicit currency and rounding rule; test fractional cents, zero-decimal and three-decimal currencies, overflow and mixed currencies on {surface}, and assert no float arithmetic and no silent rounding.
currency-precision.verify: Property test over amounts and splits asserting the parts sum to the whole; boundary tests for JPY, KWD, very large values and negative amounts; static check that no float type touches amounts.

refund-reversal-path.title: Refund and reversal path
refund-reversal-path.neg: {subject} must provide a tested reversal for every money movement, bounded by the original amount; test partial, repeated and post-settlement refunds and a chargeback on {surface}, and assert totals never exceed what was captured and entitlements follow.
refund-reversal-path.verify: Test partial refund twice, refund above the original, refund after a payout and a dispute; assert the ledger balances and the customer-visible state matches.

ledger-reconciliation.title: Ledger reconciliation with the processor
ledger-reconciliation.neg: {subject} must reconcile its ledger against the processor or bank records and surface a discrepancy; test a missing webhook, a duplicated webhook and an out-of-order event on {surface}, and assert the ledger converges and an alert names the gap.
ledger-reconciliation.verify: Replay a processor export against the ledger with injected drift; assert every mismatch is reported, webhooks are verified and idempotent, and the daily total equals the processor total.

authorization-vs-capture.title: Authorization versus capture
authorization-vs-capture.neg: {subject} must distinguish an authorization from a capture and release uncaptured holds; test an expired authorization, a capture above the authorized amount and a cancelled order on {surface}, and assert funds are never granted before capture and holds are released.
authorization-vs-capture.verify: State-machine test across authorize, capture, void and expiry; assert no entitlement before capture and that the processor state and local state agree after each transition.

device-identity-binding.title: Device identity binding
device-identity-binding.neg: {subject} must bind credentials and grants to a device identity that cannot be copied or spoofed by replaying an identifier; test a cloned identifier, a re-imaged device and a second device with the same name on {surface} and assert they are rejected or re-enrolled explicitly.
device-identity-binding.verify: Test: reuse another device id and token from a second client, reset the device and re-enroll; assert the old credential is revoked and the audit log names both devices.

unattended-recovery.title: Unattended recovery
unattended-recovery.neg: {subject} must recover without a person at the machine unless the spec says a person is required; test a reboot, a lost session and a stuck prompt on {surface} with nobody present, and assert it returns to a working state or raises a remote-visible alert.
unattended-recovery.verify: Reboot and kill the agent on an idle headless host; assert automatic recovery within the stated bound, or a remote alert, with no dialog that needs a local click.

grant-durability.title: Grant durability
grant-durability.neg: {subject} must not let approvals or grants expire or re-prompt silently; test the grant after a restart, an update and the passage of time on {surface}, and assert it still holds or the loss is visible and recoverable.
grant-durability.verify: Restart, update and advance the clock past any TTL; assert the grant persists, or that expiry is explicit in the spec, logged and alerted.

remote-exec-audit.title: Remote execution audit
remote-exec-audit.neg: {subject} must record who ran what, on which device and when, for every remote command on {surface}, with secrets redacted; test a command, a failed command and a rejected command and assert each yields an audit entry that cannot be altered by the target.
remote-exec-audit.verify: Run allowed, denied and failing commands; assert complete append-only audit records with actor, device, command digest and result, and that secrets do not appear.

factory-reset-guard.title: Factory reset and wipe guard
factory-reset-guard.neg: {subject} must not factory reset, wipe or unenroll a device without a bound, fresh, explicit approval for that device; test a replayed approval, a wrong-device id and a bulk request on {surface} and assert refusal and an audit entry.
factory-reset-guard.verify: Test with a stale approval, an approval for another device and a fleet-wide call; assert nothing is wiped and the refusal names the mismatch.

derived-gate-floor-with-ratchet.title: Derived gate floor with ratchet
derived-gate-floor-with-ratchet.neg: {subject} must derive any minimum (test count, coverage, size) from the previous release and only let it rise; test {surface} by deleting tests and by adding tests, and assert the gate fails on a drop and the floor ratchets up, with no hard-coded number in the gate.
derived-gate-floor-with-ratchet.verify: Delete a test and assert the gate fails against the derived floor; add tests and assert the stored floor rises; grep the gate source for literal counts.

artifact-inventory-mirrored.title: Artifact inventory mirrored at build time
artifact-inventory-mirrored.neg: {subject} must store every signed artifact on at least two hosts or Dropbox at build time, listed in an inventory; test {surface} with one host unavailable and assert the build fails or flags it when an artifact exists on only one host.
artifact-inventory-mirrored.verify: At build end, compare the inventory with each location by checksum; remove one copy and assert the check fails naming the artifact that exists on only one host.

self-update-e2e.title: Self-update from the previous version
self-update-e2e.neg: {subject} must prove an update from version N-1 to N on an idle headless host; test the real updater on {surface} and assert the new version runs, state is preserved and a failed update leaves the old version working.
self-update-e2e.verify: Install N-1 on an idle headless host, publish N to the feed, observe the update through logs and version output, then repeat with a corrupt payload and assert rollback to N-1.

transport-proof.title: Prove the transport you will use
transport-proof.neg: {subject} must be exercised over the exact transport the integration will use (for example MCP, not only REST) with real credentials, and error bodies must be captured; test {surface} and assert a 403 or error over that transport is recorded verbatim in the evidence.
transport-proof.verify: Smoke test through the production transport and auth path, saving status and body for success and for forced failures; assert the evidence contains response bodies, not only status codes.

rollback-not-blocked.title: Rollback is never blocked
rollback-not-blocked.neg: {subject} must never block an emergency rollback with a preflight, lock or gate; test a rollback on {surface} while a gate is failing and while another release is in flight, and assert it proceeds with an audit note.
rollback-not-blocked.verify: Force every preflight check to fail and run the rollback path; assert it still completes, restores the previous artifact and records who and why.

staging-exists.title: Staging rehearsal exists
staging-exists.neg: {subject} must be rehearsed in a staging environment that matches production for {surface} before release; assert the release record names the staging run, its commit and result, and that a missing staging target fails the release.
staging-exists.verify: Run the release against staging and capture the deployed commit and smoke result; assert the production step refuses when no matching staging evidence exists.

evm.title: EVM (Solidity, Foundry, Hardhat, ethers/viem/web3)
evm.subject: the contract or EVM client
evm.surface: each external or public function and each value transfer

reentrancy.verify: forge invariant test with a handler plus a malicious receiver contract; Slither reentrancy detectors; assert nonReentrant or checks-effects-interactions on every value-moving path.

replay-chainid.verify: EIP-712 domain includes chainId and verifyingContract; test with vm.chainId() changed and with an ecrecover malleable signature.

finality-reorg.verify: Indexer/backend tests that revert to an anvil snapshot (evm_snapshot/evm_revert, a hint, not a true reorg) and tests with the finalized block tag; require N confirmations or finalized before crediting.

scaffolds.title: Local anvil and fork tests
scaffolds.notes: Pin the fork block for determinism; keep RPC URLs and keys out of the repo and logs.

scaffolds.title: Foundry invariant tests with handlers
scaffolds.notes: Use a handler with ghost variables and targetContract/targetSelector; set invariant runs/depth in foundry.toml and review fail_on_revert and show_metrics so reverting handlers cannot hide a vacuous run.

scaffolds.title: Property fuzzing with Echidna or Medusa
scaffolds.notes: Echidna properties return bool; keep a failing control (a deliberately broken variant) to prove the property can fail.

scaffolds.title: Hardhat local network tests
scaffolds.notes: Use hardhat_reset/forking with a pinned block for fork tests.

prompts: List every external/public entry point and its access modifier, and show a negative test for each privileged one.
Walk each value-moving function for reentrancy and cross-function reentrancy; show the attacker test.
Write a Foundry handler-based invariant test for the conservation of value, with a deliberately broken variant that must fail.
Check upgrade safety: initializer guards, storage layout diff, and a fork test of the upgrade against live state.
Review signature flows for chainId, verifyingContract, nonce and deadline binding and malleability.

solana.title: Solana / Anchor
solana.subject: the program
solana.surface: each instruction and each account it accepts

access-control.neg: {subject} must reject an instruction when a signer, owner, PDA seed/bump, program id or account discriminator check fails, and when accounts are substituted, duplicated or passed with the wrong owner for {surface}.
access-control.verify: Anchor tests passing wrong signer, wrong owner, fake PDA and duplicate mutable accounts; has_one/constraint on every account.

reentrancy.neg: {subject} must not be exploitable through cross-program invocation (CPI) re-entry or arbitrary CPI target program ids for {surface}.
reentrancy.verify: Test a malicious program as CPI callee; verify program id of every CPI target.

precision.verify: checked_add/checked_mul on all u64/u128 math, tests at u64::MAX and token decimals 0/6/9; proptest over amounts.

gas-dos.neg: {subject} must stay within the compute-unit budget and account size/rent limits for {surface}; an attacker must not be able to bloat, close-and-revive or starve accounts.
gas-dos.verify: Measure compute units in tests at worst-case account counts; test account closing and revival.

upgradeability.verify: Upgrade authority held by a multisig or revoked; account struct versioning and realloc tests against old serialized data.

replay-chainid.neg: {subject} must not let a signed transaction or message be replayed: stale recent_blockhash, reused durable nonce account state, or a signature reused across programs and clusters for {surface}.
replay-chainid.verify: Test an expired blockhash, a reused durable nonce and a message signed for another program id; assert refusal.

finality-reorg.neg: {subject} must act on {surface} only at the required commitment level (confirmed or finalized, never processed for value) and handle dropped transactions and forks by re-checking signature status.
finality-reorg.verify: Test with commitment levels and a dropped/expired transaction; assert no credit before finalized and no duplicate credit on resubmit.

scaffolds.title: Anchor tests on a local validator
scaffolds.notes: anchor test starts a local validator itself; run solana-test-validator --reset separately only with --skip-local-validator, and never both on the same port.

scaffolds.title: Fast SBF unit and in-process tests (cargo test-sbf, LiteSVM or solana-bankrun)
scaffolds.notes: Use for clock warps and compute-unit assertions.

scaffolds.title: Fuzzing with Trident or proptest
scaffolds.notes: Add a deliberately broken variant to prove the harness can fail.

prompts: For each instruction list the accounts, their owner/signer/seed constraints and the test that passes a wrong one.
Check every CPI for program id validation and signer-seed use, and arithmetic for checked math.
Review account close/realloc paths and upgrade authority custody.

substrate.title: Substrate / Polkadot SDK pallets and runtimes
substrate.subject: the pallet or runtime
substrate.surface: each dispatchable and each hook (on_initialize, on_finalize)

access-control.neg: {subject} must reject unsigned, wrong-origin and non-root calls to {surface}; every dispatchable checks ensure_signed/ensure_root/EnsureOrigin as intended.
access-control.verify: Mock-runtime tests with each origin type; assert BadOrigin.

gas-dos.neg: {subject} must charge correct weights and bound storage iteration for {surface}; no unbounded loops or storage growth that an attacker can force.
gas-dos.verify: Benchmarks with worst-case components, weight regression check, and BoundedVec limits tested.

upgradeability.neg: {subject} must ship a storage migration with version checks for every storage layout change, and runtime upgrades must be tested against a snapshot of live state.
upgradeability.verify: try-runtime on-runtime-upgrade against live state; StorageVersion bumped and checked.

precision.verify: Saturating/checked arithmetic and Perbill/FixedU128 rounding tests at boundaries; proptest over amounts.

replay-chainid.neg: {subject} must bind signed extrinsics to the genesis hash, spec version, transaction version, nonce and mortality era so {surface} cannot be replayed on another chain or after a runtime upgrade.
replay-chainid.verify: Test an extrinsic signed for another genesis hash and an expired era; assert InvalidTransaction.

finality-reorg.neg: {subject} must treat {surface} as final only at the GRANDPA-finalized head, not the best head, and must reconcile derived state when a fork is abandoned.
finality-reorg.verify: Test with a best-head fork switch and assert credits happen only after finalization (chain_getFinalizedHead).

scaffolds.title: Pallet mock runtime unit tests
scaffolds.notes: Test each origin and error variant.

scaffolds.title: try-runtime and zombienet
scaffolds.notes: Run upgrade tests against a snapshot, not a production endpoint with write access.

scaffolds.title: Property tests
scaffolds.notes: Prove failure with a seeded broken variant.

prompts: List each dispatchable with its origin check, weight and the test for the wrong origin.
Check storage migrations and StorageVersion for every storage item changed in this diff.
Review hooks for unbounded work and weight accounting.

xrpl.title: XRP Ledger (xrpl.js, xrpl-py, rippled)
xrpl.subject: the XRPL client or service
xrpl.surface: each transaction type submitted or observed

precision.neg: {subject} must handle XRP drops (integer) and issued-currency amounts (15-digit mantissa) without floating point, rounding or truncation for {surface}; amounts must be strings, never JS numbers or floats. Credit the delivered_amount of a payment, never its Amount field (partial payments).
precision.verify: Boundary tests with 1 drop, max supply, 1e-15 issued amounts, and round-trip through the library's amount types.

nonce-idempotency.neg: {subject} must manage account Sequence/Ticket numbers and LastLedgerSequence so a retried or duplicated {surface} applies at most once and an expired transaction is never silently resubmitted with a new sequence.
nonce-idempotency.verify: Resubmit identical signed blob, expire via LastLedgerSequence, and assert one validated result by transaction hash.

finality-reorg.neg: {subject} must treat {surface} as final only when the transaction is in a validated ledger (validated: true) with tesSUCCESS, never from tentative or tec/tem/ter results alone.
finality-reorg.verify: Standalone rippled test that submits without ledger_accept (not validated) and with it; assert credits only after validated result.

replay-chainid.neg: {subject} must set NetworkID for networks that require it and reject signed blobs for another network for {surface}.
replay-chainid.verify: Test submit of a mainnet-signed blob against testnet/standalone config.

access-control.neg: {subject} must honour account flags (RequireAuth, DisallowXRP, deposit authorization, regular key vs master key disabled) when handling {surface}.
access-control.verify: Standalone tests with each account flag set.

scaffolds.title: Local standalone rippled
scaffolds.notes: Standalone mode does not advance ledgers automatically; call ledger_accept to validate. Pin any container image by digest; the faucet exists only on test networks.

scaffolds.title: Property tests for amounts
scaffolds.notes: Use hypothesis (xrpl-py) or fast-check (xrpl.js) over drops and issued amounts.

prompts: Show how each submitted transaction is tracked to a validated ledger, with LastLedgerSequence and the retry policy.
Review all amount handling for float use and drops/issued-currency boundaries.
Check regular-key, signing-list and deposit-auth handling for the accounts involved.

ledger-messaging.title: Ledger/journal over protobuf and NATS
ledger-messaging.subject: the ledger service
ledger-messaging.surface: each posting, journal entry and message subject

precision.neg: {subject} must store money as integer minor units or fixed-point decimal and never float; protobuf int64/uint64 fields must be checked for overflow and sign for {surface}.
precision.verify: Property test that every journal balances to zero (debits == credits) across random amounts, currencies and scales.

nonce-idempotency.neg: {subject} must apply a redelivered, duplicated or reordered message ({surface}) exactly once using a durable idempotency key, including after consumer crash and JetStream redelivery.
nonce-idempotency.verify: Deliver each message twice and out of order, kill the consumer between apply and ack, assert balances unchanged by the duplicate.

finality-reorg.neg: {subject} must not acknowledge a message before the posting is durably committed, and must define behaviour for a lost ack, a poison message and a replay from sequence zero.
finality-reorg.verify: Fault test killing the process before/after commit and before ack; replay the stream into an empty store and compare balances.

access-control.neg: {subject} must authorize publishers and subscribers per subject (NATS accounts/permissions) and reject postings from an unauthorized or tenant-mismatched publisher for {surface}.
access-control.verify: NATS permission test with a client lacking publish rights; tenant isolation test.

upgradeability.neg: {subject} must keep protobuf schema evolution backward and forward compatible (no reused field numbers, unknown fields preserved) for {surface}.
upgradeability.verify: buf breaking in CI and a test that decodes messages produced by the previous schema.

key-custody.neg: {subject} must keep NATS credentials, signing keys and database secrets out of logs, messages and config in the repo, and rotate them without replaying {surface}.
key-custody.verify: Secret scan in CI and a test that message payload logging redacts credential fields.

gas-dos.neg: {subject} must bound message size, consumer backlog, pending acks and per-tenant rate for {surface} so a flood or poison message cannot stall the ledger.
gas-dos.verify: Load test with oversized, flooded and poison messages; assert dead-lettering and bounded memory.

scaffolds.title: Local NATS JetStream
scaffolds.notes: Use a throwaway store dir; test redelivery with MaxDeliver and AckWait set small.

scaffolds.title: Ledger property tests
scaffolds.notes: Assert the double-entry invariant after every random operation sequence.

prompts: Prove that every journal balances and that redelivery cannot post twice, with a crash between commit and ack.
Check protobuf schema evolution rules and subject-level authorization.
Review amount types end to end for float or overflow.

auth.title: Authentication, sessions and account identity
auth.subject: the authentication flow
auth.surface: each sign-up, login, recovery, invite and session path

delete.title: Destructive deletes and cleanup
delete.subject: the delete or cleanup operation
